claims: C1 the content of a message is a sequence of chunks
C2 each chunk is text, untrusted text, or multimodal data (e.g., image or audio)

concepts.name: message_content
concepts.gloss: the content of a message, being a sequence of data chunks

concepts.name: text_chunk
concepts.gloss: a chunk of data that is plain text

concepts.name: untrusted_text_chunk
concepts.gloss: a chunk of data that is untrusted text

concepts.name: multimodal_chunk
concepts.gloss: a chunk of data that is multimodal, such as an image or audio

concepts.name: content_chunk
concepts.gloss: chunk C is a member of the sequence that constitutes message content M

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts

ontology.gloss: M is the content of a message, being a sequence of chunks
C is a text chunk within message content M
C is an untrusted text chunk within message content M
C is a multimodal chunk within message content M
